material.head: A* setup: wave 2 of wave 3
material.text: Five clean waves up from Mar 30 to Aug 5 (+55%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−1.7% to −9.1%), in three waves, with the 50-day average and the 200-week average in the same place. It is the second wave of a larger wave 3: five waves up from Aug 7, 2025 to Jan 16 and a pullback of 0.79 of them to the Mar 30 low came first, so the end of this wave 2 starts wave 3 of 3, the strongest move a chart makes. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−19%); a close over the wave-1 high (+26%) says wave 3 is under way.
material.learn: After five waves up the pullback usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance; a close turning up there is the buy.

material.head: Sitting on stacked support
material.text: Price sits on the April breakout level, the 50-day average and the average price paid since the Oct 14 low, where 7 levels (4 kinds) meet.
material.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.

material.head: Next support −4.9% below
material.text: The next floor under it is −4.9% below (1.6 ATR), where 3 levels (3 kinds) meet: the 200-week average, the 61.8% retracement of the Oct 14–Oct 22 rise and the May 14 low.
material.learn: A price where buyers stepped in before.

material.head: Selling is losing force
material.text: A lower low in price (Oct 14) against a higher low in momentum (5 of 7 gauges): regular bullish divergence.
material.learn: Lower price lows with rising momentum lows: sellers are tiring.

material.head: A possible double bottom
material.text: It bottomed twice at one level (Sep 10 and Oct 14); a close above the peak between them confirms the double bottom.
material.learn: Two lows at one price with a peak between; the pattern counts once price closes over that peak.

material.learn: A sharp move (the pole), then a shallow drift on light volume (the flag); the next leg often matches much of the pole.
